about: The tunnels between Lumbridge Castle's cellar, the Dorgeshuun mines and the water mill cellar after The Lost Tribe and Death to the Dorgeshuun (post-quest step 6, DorgeshuunTunnels.kt): the three guides and Nardok. Each is the cache's multinpc, which shows its after-quest form. Tiles from each NPC's OSRS Wiki map (read 2026-11-19); none wanders (Kazgar and Dartog stand guard; Mistag and Nardok guessed).

spawns.source: Kazgar, in the tunnel by Lumbridge Castle's cellar. OSRS Wiki, Kazgar (3230,9611)
Mistag, in the Dorgeshuun mines. OSRS Wiki, Mistag (3320,9615)
Dartog, at the tunnel to the water mill cellar. OSRS Wiki, Dartog (3246,9648)
Nardok, in the Dorgeshuun mines by Dorgesh-Kaan's door. OSRS Wiki, Nardok (3322,9608)
